title: Wag Walk Session Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wag:walk distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by walker_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks walker values by total and average distance across Wag walk session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each Wag walk session event and review total and average distance by walker.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly which walker shows the biggest distance numbers in your Wag walk session data.
